description: The CoupleFlow wordmark rendered on the welcome/entry screen. Reproduces the auth-screen mark ('Couple ♥ Flow') so the first impression matches register/login. Replaces the old plain text badge 'CoupleFlow'. Fully tokenized: uses colors.accent for the heart instead of the off-token pink #ec4899 used by the auth screens (flagged for app-wide reconciliation).

designSystem.layout: horizontal Text + Ionicons(heart) + Text, spacing.xs gap, centered

accessibility.label: CoupleFlow
accessibility.note: Meaning does not depend on color; the heart is decorative

developerNotes: Auth screens hardcode #ec4899 for the heart/'Flow'. This uses colors.accent to stay tokenized. If the exact pink is required, add colors.brandPink to design-system.ts and use it across welcome/register/login — do not one-off.
